title: Judge directs President Trump to sit for deposition in his $10 billion lawsuit against the BBC - NBC News
description: A federal judge in Florida on Thursday ordered President Donald Trump to sit for a deposition in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC by Dec. 11 or face the possibility of having his $10 billion action dismissed.
